ayahs.ar: وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَرۡوًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa
ayahs.en: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing

ayahs.ar: فَالۡحٰمِلٰتِ وِقۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Falhaamilaati wiqraa
ayahs.en: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

ayahs.ar: فَالۡجٰرِيٰتِ يُسۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Faljaariyaati yusraa
ayahs.en: And those [ships] sailing with ease

ayahs.ar: فَالۡمُقَسِّمٰتِ اَمۡرًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Falmuqassimaati amraa
ayahs.en: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لَصَادِقٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq
ayahs.en: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

ayahs.ar: وَّاِنَّ الدِّيۡنَ لَوَاقِعٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa innad deena la waaqi'
ayahs.en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ الۡحُبُكِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk
ayahs.en: By the heaven containing pathways,

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكُمۡ لَفِيۡ قَوۡلٍ مُّخۡتَلِفٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif
ayahs.en: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

ayahs.ar: يُّؤۡفَكُ عَنۡهُ مَنۡ اُفِكَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik
ayahs.en: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ الۡخَرّٰصُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qutilal kharraasoon
ayahs.en: Destroyed are the falsifiers

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِيۡ غَمۡرَةٍ سَاهُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon
ayahs.en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

ayahs.ar: يَسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ الدِّيۡنِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen
ayahs.en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ هُمۡ عَلَي النَّارِ يُفۡتَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon
ayahs.en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

ayahs.ar: ذُوۡقُوۡا فِتۡنَتَكُمۡؕ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon
ayahs.en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

ayahs.ar: اٰخِذِيۡنَ مَا٘ اٰتٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَبۡلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen
ayahs.en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

ayahs.ar: كَانُوۡا قَلِيۡلًا مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon
ayahs.en: They used to sleep but little of the night,

ayahs.ar: وَبِالۡاَسۡحَارِ هُمۡ يَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon
ayahs.en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

ayahs.ar: وَفِيۡ٘ اَمۡوَالِهِمۡ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَالۡمَحۡرُوۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom
ayahs.en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

ayahs.ar: وَفِي الۡاَرۡضِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلۡمُوۡقِنِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen
ayahs.en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

ayahs.ar: وَفِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon
ayahs.en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

ayahs.ar: وَفِي السَّمَآءِ رِزۡقُكُمۡ وَمَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon
ayahs.en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّ مِّثۡلَ مَا٘ اَنَّكُمۡ تَنۡطِقُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon
ayahs.en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيۡثُ ضَيۡفِ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen
ayahs.en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَقَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌۚ قَوۡمٌ مُّنۡكَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon
ayahs.en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهٖ فَجَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ سَمِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen
ayahs.en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَّبَهٗ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ قَالَ اَلَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

ayahs.ar: فَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيۡفَةًؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡؕ وَبَشَّرُوۡهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem
ayahs.en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

ayahs.ar: فَاَقۡبَلَتِ امۡرَاَتُهٗ فِيۡ صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتۡ وَجۡهَهَا وَقَالَتۡ عَجُوۡزٌ عَقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem
ayahs.en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا كَذٰلِكِۙ قَالَ رَبُّكِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem
ayahs.en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكُمۡ اَيُّهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon
ayahs.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي قَوۡمٍ مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

ayahs.ar: لِنُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ طِيۡنٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen
ayahs.en: To send down upon them stones of clay,

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُسۡرِفِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen
ayahs.en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مَنۡ كَانَ فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا وَجَدۡنَا فِيۡهَا غَيۡرَ بَيۡتٍ مِّنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen
ayahs.en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكۡنَا فِيۡهَا٘ اٰيَةً لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يَخَافُوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِيۡمَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem
ayahs.en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَفِيۡ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنٰهُ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen
ayahs.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي بِرُكۡنِهٖ وَقَالَ سٰحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon
ayahs.en: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ وَجُنُوۡدَهٗ فَنَبَذۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيۡمٌؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem
ayahs.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

ayahs.ar: وَفِيۡ عَادٍ اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمُ الرِّيۡحَ الۡعَقِيۡمَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem
ayahs.en: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

ayahs.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ اَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ اِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَالرَّمِيۡمِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem
ayahs.en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

ayahs.ar: وَفِيۡ ثَمُوۡدَ اِذۡ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ تَمَتَّعُوۡا حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen
ayahs.en: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

ayahs.ar: فَعَتَوۡا عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهِمۡ فَاَخَذَتۡهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon
ayahs.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

ayahs.ar: فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مِنۡ قِيَامٍ وَّمَا كَانُوۡا مُنۡتَصِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen
ayahs.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen
ayahs.en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّمَآءَ بَنَيۡنٰهَا بِاَيۡىدٍ وَّاِنَّا لَمُوۡسِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon
ayahs.en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡاَرۡضَ فَرَشۡنٰهَا فَنِعۡمَ الۡمٰهِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon
ayahs.en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.

ayahs.ar: فَفِرُّوۡ٘ا اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَؕ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ مَا٘ اَتَي الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوۡا سَاحِرٌ اَوۡ مَجۡنُوۡنٌࣞ‏
ayahs.tl: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon
ayahs.en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

ayahs.ar: اَتَوَاصَوۡا بِهٖۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon
ayahs.en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِمَلُوۡمٍؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom
ayahs.en: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.

ayahs.ar: وَّذَكِّرۡ فَاِنَّ الذِّكۡرٰي تَنۡفَعُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ الۡجِنَّ وَالۡاِنۡسَ اِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon
ayahs.en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

ayahs.ar: مَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ مِنۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّزۡقٍ وَّمَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّطۡعِمُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon
ayahs.en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الۡقُوَّةِ الۡمَتِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا ذَنُوۡبًا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوۡبِ اَصۡحٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon
ayahs.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.

ayahs.ar: فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ يَّوۡمِهِمُ الَّذِيۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon
ayahs.en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
